n, k, p = map(int, input().split())
ans = pow(k, n, p)

if n % 2 == 0:
    fac = [1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % p
    inv = [1] * (n + 1)
    inv[n] = pow(fac[n], p - 2, p)
    for i in range(n, 0, -1):
        inv[i - 1] = inv[i] * i % p
    
    f = [{} for _ in range(26)]
    
    def solve(cur, S):
        if S in f[cur]:
            return f[cur][S]
        if S == 0:
            res = fac[n]
            for i in range(1, cur + 1):
                res = res * (k - i + 1) % p
            f[cur][S] = res
            return res
        lowbit = S & -S
        U = S - lowbit
        res = 0
        T = U
        while T:
            res = (res + inv[S - T] * solve(cur + 1, T)) % p
            T = (T - 1) & U
        res = (res + inv[S] * solve(cur + 1, 0)) % p
        f[cur][S] = res
        return res
    
    ans = (ans - solve(0, n) + p) % p

print(ans)
